_doc: Story & audio targets plus the per-production script.json contract consumed by engine/audio/tts.py (TTS + timing stage). Derived from 10 sample Shorts. Human-readable rationale: the STORY & AUDIO FORMULA doc. Token = whitespace-separated word of a line's `text` (punctuation attached, digits count as 1 token), 0-based within the line.

measured._cols: dur_s, tokens (en-orig ASR), wpm (tokens/runtime), pauses_ge_0p6s, numeral_tokens, hero_intro_s, inciting_s, music_turn_s (30-120 Hz floor step), twist_s, lufs, lra, tp_dbtp, title_pattern

story.pov: first person kid narrator (default) or third-person storyteller

music.turn_anchor: first token of the inciting line (+-0.2 s)
music.end: hard stop at last word end + <=300 ms (30-80 ms fade), no outro

lint: tokens and duration inside targets.story ranges (warn), inside hard ranges (fail)
L01 starts with 'In this world,' or 'In this town,' and its last token ends <= 4.5 s
the second line starts with 'You see,'
exactly one line has beat 'inciting'; it starts at 38-47% of runtime; a music cue with role 'turn' is anchored at its token 0
the first 'twist' line starts at 66-78%; the first 'payoff' line at >= 85%; the 'ending' lines start at >= 94%
every plant: set_up line comes before paid_off line; >= 3 plants
at least one 'climax' line has hero_action=true (the protagonist's own decision resolves the story)
numeral tokens >= 8; no line > 32 tokens; last line <= 8 tokens
measured wpm 255-270 after TTS (re-render with speed *= wpm_target/wpm_measured once if outside)
<= 10 sfx cues; music stop resolves to <= 300 ms after the last word end
no CTA tokens: subscribe, like, comment, follow, part 2

premise.description: One sentence world rule; usually identical to L01

voice.description: {preset: name} from engine/voices.json (script keys override it; no voice/engine = its default, ElevenLabs), or a full object: kokoro {voice, speed, target_wpm} or elevenlabs {voice_id, model_id, voice_settings, target_wpm}

preset.description: engine/voices.json preset name, e.g. lukas, kokoro_fenrir

voice.description: kokoro: e.g. am_fenrir, am_michael, af_heart, or 'a+b' blend

role.description: bed = act-1 light bed; turn = bass/drone layer at the inciting line; lift = optional swell at reveal/payoff; stop = hard end

mood.description: e.g. whimsical-curious, mysterious, dark-emotional, tense, warm-resolve

track.description: optional explicit file/title; filled by the music stage if absent

mode.description: add = layer over the running bed; replace = crossfade

word.description: optional sanity check: must equal token w (punctuation-insensitive)

text.description: Exactly what the captions show. Numbers as digits. One or more sentences.

say.description: token -> spoken form override, e.g. {"1952": "nineteen fifty-two"}; the caption keeps the token, the timing of the token spans the spoken form

emphasis.description: token indexes that carry the beat; drive punch-ins, face swaps, SFX hits. NOT caption styling, NOT TTS stress (Kokoro has none)

pause_after_ms.description: silence after this line; default voice.line_gap_ms

speed.description: optional per-line Kokoro speed override (use sparingly, +-0.05)

delivery.description: hint; used only by expressive engines

dialogue.description: quoted speech, still in the narrator's voice

w.description: cut lands on this token's start (minus 1 frame)

hint.description: literal picture of what the words say

move.description: camera/ module move name, default push_in

id.description: procedural name (whoosh, swoosh, impact_boom, sub_drop, hit, pop, ding, heartbeat, clock_tick, ...) or library asset id

timing_output._doc: productions/<slug>/timing.json written by the TTS stage; production.js reads timing.words[i].start/end
timing_output.duration: number, seconds (last word end + stop tail)
timing_output.wpm: number, tokens / (last word end - first word start) * 60
timing_output.words: [{i, line, w, text, start, end}] one entry per script token, in order; end includes no trailing pause
timing_output.beats: {beat: [start, end]} first-to-last line of each beat
timing_output.cues: {music: [{id, role, t, ...}], sfx: [{id, t, gain_db, ...}], shots: [{line, w, t, hint, ...}]} anchors resolved to seconds

example_lines.text: In this world, the sea goes out for one hour a year, and whatever you carry back is yours.

shots.hint: frame 0 zoom-blur in: kid sprinting across wet seabed hugging a gold anchor
aerial: drained bay, ships on their sides, hundreds running out with wheelbarrows, sea a wall on the horizon

water receding fast from the harbor wall (time-lapse)
lighthouse with the sea pulling away behind it
